trigger_condition: Client-supplied log field contains a double quote or backslash
potential_consequence: Non-local LOG_FORMAT builds JSON by interpolation; quote corrupts or forges the record

trigger_condition: ValidationError details reach the new WARNING from stored auth_config
potential_consequence: Pydantic input_value echoes stored auth_config (client_secret ciphertext) into central logs

trigger_condition: Unauthenticated GET /oauth2/callback with CR/LF inside first 12 state chars
guard_snippet: return _sanitize_log_value(state[:12]) if isinstance(state, str) else None
potential_consequence: Forged log lines from _oauth2_callback.py:482 and :525 entry/IdP-error logs

trigger_condition: OAuth2 scope has two values, so the logged value contains spaces
guard_snippet: fields[key] = None if raw is None else f'"{_sanitize_log_value(raw)}"'
potential_consequence: Space-bearing values break key=value parsing, so log joins silently mis-field

trigger_condition: Caller sends unknown discovered_flow_id with CR/LF or megabyte length
potential_consequence: Authenticated user forges log records and inflates log volume without bound

trigger_condition: New INFO f-string raises anything while inside the surrounding try
guard_snippet: move the logger.info(...) call below the except blocks, after the try succeeds
potential_consequence: except Exception downgrades an already-stored successful resolution to discovered_flow_resolution_failed

trigger_condition: navigator.sendBeacon returns false (queue full, payload refused)
guard_snippet: if (navigator.sendBeacon(url, blob)) return  // else fall through to fetch
potential_consequence: Timeout diagnostics silently dropped; backend never records the missing callback

trigger_condition: Configured MCP_AUTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS exceeds 3600, or timeoutMs is fractional/negative
potential_consequence: Backend Field(ge=0, le=3_600_000) rejects with 422; beacon lost exactly when needed

trigger_condition: Opener tab backgrounded during OAuth popup, so timer firing is throttled
potential_consequence: waited_ms logs the nominal timeout, understating real wait in the diagnosed case

trigger_condition: Any assertion in the four new tests fails before the trailing cleanup
potential_consequence: Stubbed navigator leaks into later tests, cascading unrelated failures in the suite
